ci_fix_attempts.attempt_1: CI failed twice (runs 43442743028 attempts 1-2) inside test.sh; GitHub job logs unavailable (Azure BlobNotFound for both attempts and reruns), failure not attributable from evidence. Analysis: tests duplicated the 780MB checkpoint twice via full copytree (2 x 780MB extra disk + en_core_web_lg 400MB + venv ~5GB on a ~14GB runner). Fix: disk-bounded hardlinked checkpoint copies (hardlink same-fs, copy2 fallback), tamper only tiny files (gliner_config.json/vocabulary.txt) or a head-modified safetensors copy; added missing-whisper-snapshot test. All 7 tests green locally (unit suite 51 passed).
